contract: Open a seekable Ogg source and fold the track properties available at open. The reference forces the Ogg demuxer through memory AVIO, with no stream-info pass. Compare stream order, codec, rate and channels, reduced Theora frame rate, end in stream ticks, header error and configuration presence, and codec tag.

Project FLAC to STREAMINFO and take reference channels and rate from it. Compare OpusHead and the Speex identification packet byte for byte. Split Xiph lacing and the reference's Theora big-endian 16-bit length fields into identification and setup packets. Compare the comments through their dictionary projection.

Sort the UTF-8 comment pairs by ASCII-lowercased key and value. Map ALBUMARTIST, TRACKNUMBER, DISCNUMBER and DESCRIPTION to album_artist, track, disc and comment. Ignore the vendor string and any comment framing bit. A valid METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE contributes its image payload in the separate attachment records, sorted by bytes after all track records.

For Opus, convert the reference duration to the end on the audible timeline by subtracting pre-skip. For other mappings use the stream end in ticks derived from the reference duration and any available start time. A demuxer that fails to open emits a refusal.

open_deviations.reading: Chapter comments are still source comments
open_deviations.clause: Xiph Vorbis I section 5.2 and Xiph VorbisComment chapter extension define the textual comment field and the CHAPTERxxx names.
open_deviations.candidate: retains the chapter keys and values alongside the ordinary fields
open_deviations.reference: exports chapters separately and omits the keys from the stream dictionary

open_deviations.reading: Use the last Opus granule and pre-skip for the source end
open_deviations.clause: RFC 3533 section 6 and RFC 7845 sections 4.2–4.4 define the page granule and conversion to PCM samples by subtracting pre-skip, including at EOS.
open_deviations.candidate: publishes 59232 ticks from the EOS granule 59544 less 312 samples of pre-skip
open_deviations.reference: reports duration corresponding to 64032 ticks after a CRC failure

open_deviations.reading: Preserve the Speex final source granule
open_deviations.clause: RFC 3533 section 6 assigns granule_position to the logical stream. Xiph Speex manual, Formats and standards, Speex in Ogg, gives the mapping’s sample clock and packet framing.
open_deviations.candidate: reports the EOS granules 9872, 9600 and 28800 samples
open_deviations.reference: publishes durations of 9920, 10560 and 29149 ticks from the demux stream

open_deviations.reading: Retain the Skeleton identification packet as opaque configuration
open_deviations.clause: RFC 3533 section 3 and the Xiph Ogg Skeleton Metadata Bitstream, Identifying the Ogg Skeleton, define the BOS identification packet. Track::configuration retains the first packet of an opaque mapping.
open_deviations.candidate: publishes the fishead signature and its original configuration bytes
open_deviations.reference: publishes the stream without configuration bytes

open_deviations.reading: An empty text value is present in the comment packet
open_deviations.clause: Xiph Vorbis I section 5.2 defines length-delimited UTF-8 name=value fields and specifies no minimum value length.
open_deviations.candidate: reports the present TITLE with a zero-byte value
open_deviations.reference: omits the empty TITLE from the dictionary

open_deviations.reading: Expose a valid Opus identification with the error in the following header
open_deviations.clause: RFC 7845 sections 5.1 and 5.2 require the identification and comment packets and allow refusal of a short comment. Track::header_error exposes a failed header without losing source identification.
open_deviations.candidate: retains the OpusHead and reports a second-header error

open_deviations.reading: A zero Theora frame-rate denominator has no frame clock
open_deviations.clause: Theora I section 6.2 requires a positive FRN and FRD; Annex A.2.3 derives the granule clock from the coded frame period.
open_deviations.candidate: reports a header error with no frame rate
